snapshot.note: Level-1 build prepared for review. The opening scene, contract and fragment installation have not been played.

identity.name: Fen Vikutā
identity.bio: An Arasaka researcher raised in Japan, born to a Japanese researcher and a Night City-born intelligence operative. Both parents were Saburo loyalists. Fen carries their legacy into a life stripped of corporate protection.

build.human_bonus: Standard human: +1 to all six attributes. No starting feat.
build.reason: Broad scientific and technical competence, strong Cool, ordinary physical training. Combat Architecture supplies a limited survival margin appropriate to Ronin’s operational origin.
build.choices_status: Designed under player delegation for review; no story actions enacted.

attributes.name: Body
attributes.description: Force, lifting, Athletics and melee strength.

attributes.name: Reflexes
attributes.description: Initiative, evasion, stealth and ranged weapon handling.

attributes.name: Cool
attributes.description: Program execution, composure, influence and mental resistance.

proficiencies.languages_note: Japanese native; Streetslang; English from human language choice; Mandarin from researcher background. These grant no corporate credentials.
proficiencies.tools_note: Cybertech proficiency is retained; no kit is currently supplied by the penniless opening.

derived.ac_basis: Unarmoured: 10 + Reflexes (+1). Reference clothing grants no armour bonus.

resources.hp_note: Opening postoperative assessment is pending; maximum HP is 10. No damage or healing has been enacted.
resources.fragment_status: Agreed benefit; installation occurs in play
resources.rest_note: One tier-1 slot returns after a short or long rest. Neither automatically restores HP.

programs.name: Short Circuit
programs.summary: Overload exposed circuitry with a precise destructive packet.
programs.effect: Make one ranged program attack (+5) against a visible compatible powered target. On a hit, deal 1d10 system [force] damage. At total levels 5, 11 and 17, send 2, 3 and 4 packets respectively, each with its own attack and target. No Cool modifier is added to damage at level 1.
programs.requirements: A live route to compatible powered cyberware, an electronic actor/object or ICE. Bare organic flesh is not a target. Use ordinary AC/cover for embodied targets and virtual AC for ICE. Ordinary attack criticals and close-range disadvantage apply.
programs.scaling: Output Amplifier is a possible level-2 Firmware Upgrade, not currently installed.

programs.name: Decoy Projection
programs.summary: Forge an image or sound through nearby presentation hardware.
programs.effect: Create one sound, from a whisper to a scream, or a static object image within a 5-foot cube. An image adds no sound, smell, light or solidity. Physical interaction reveals an image. A creature examining it with an action can identify the deception with Intelligence (Investigation) DC 13. Ends on dismissal (action), replacement by another execution or after 1 minute.
programs.requirements: A reachable speaker for sound, or a suitable display/projector/compatible sensory interface for the image, plus actual access. The machinery must be able to cover the stated space. A camera cannot project; Fen does not own a free hologram emitter.
programs.scaling: Utility; no slot and no level-based increase.

programs.name: Vulnerability Tag
programs.summary: Mark a neural weakness and exploit it with each successful attack.
programs.effect: Choose a visible reachable neural or robotic target; no initial save. Your attacks against it deal an extra 1d6 tissue [necrotic] neural/integrity damage on a hit. Choose one ability: its checks have disadvantage, not its saving throws. After it reaches 0 HP, transfer the tag to another legal target with a bonus action on a subsequent turn.
programs.requirements: Compatible reachable neural or robotic hardware and a valid route/session. Cannot tag an offline unaugmented person. Normal intrusion and Trace rules apply. A lost route ends a remotely controlled effect at turn end.
programs.scaling: Tier 3–4: up to 8 hours. Tier 5+: up to 24 hours. Tier 2: still 1 hour. Firmware clearance can end it.

programs.name: Priority Command
programs.summary: Transmit a brief overriding instruction through a neural endpoint.
programs.effect: A visible compatible target makes a Cool save, DC 13. On failure it follows a one-word instruction on its next turn. Approach: moves toward you and ends its turn within 5 feet. Drop: drops what it holds and ends its turn. Flee: uses the fastest available means to move away. Grovel: falls prone and ends its turn. Halt: takes no movement or actions (a flying target moves only if necessary to stay aloft). A directly harmful or uninterpretable instruction fails. Other instructions require adjudication.
programs.requirements: An exposed compatible neural or actuator interface, a live session and an instruction it can interpret. No spoken component. Available through Combat Architecture’s expanded list; selected as one of the two known programs.
programs.scaling: One additional target per slot tier above 1; targets must be within 30 feet of one another.

features.name: Burst Processing
features.detail: Cool is your program ability. Attack +5; save DC 13. Known software is fixed between levels. One tier-1 slot returns on a short or long rest. Utilities consume no slot. One concentration program at a time; on damage make a Constitution save (+2), DC 10 or half damage, whichever is higher. After a bonus-action program, other programs on that turn may only be action utilities. All programs need their real equipment and access.

features.name: Kill Confirmation
features.summary: Gain 4 temporary HP when you reduce a hostile creature to 0 HP
features.detail: Combat Architecture, level 1. When you reduce a genuine hostile creature to 0 HP, gain temporary HP equal to Contractor level + Cool modifier (1 + 3 = 4). Temporary HP do not stack; choose the old or new amount. They are a protective margin from combat-feedback regulation, not tissue repair, and cannot revive you. No farming helpless manufactured targets.

features.name: Research Network
features.summary: Find the likely archive, department or specialist for a technical question
features.detail: You know how to identify the likely department or archive for a technical question and how to request access. Credentials, trust, time and actual access still matter. Former employment does not restore revoked permissions.

features.name: Ronin Fragment
features.detail: While slotted and operating, tolerance is twice native tolerance plus earned adaptation. Native = max(4, 6 + permanent Constitution modifier + permanent Cool modifier) = 11. Enhanced = 22; earned adaptation currently 0. Runs locally without a continuous patron connection. Normal installation shock, trauma, treatment and overload rules remain. Disabling/removal recalculates overload, not an instant episode. This preview does not enact the contract or installation.

cyberware.name: Sponsored Cybereyes
cyberware.summary: Normal vision with a restricted, advertising-heavy display
cyberware.detail: Cyan iris shells, a Chyron HUD and two empty option slots per eye. Disadvantage on sight-based Perception until replaced; hearing-only Perception is unaffected. Sight-based passive Perception 7; other senses 12. No attack, AC or saving throw penalty, blindness or obscuration. No enhanced night vision or targeting modules.

cyberware.name: Rocklin Augmentics NP-1
cyberware.summary: Biomonitor, holophone, HUD, personal link and shard interface
cyberware.detail: Includes Neural Link, virtuality, two shard sockets and support for five neuralware options. Those physical option slots do not increase Load tolerance. Controller sits behind the right ear. NP-1 is our campaign model designation. No premium enhancement or free intrusion bypass. When Ronin’s runtime is installed it uses one shard socket.

inventory.name: Clothing
inventory.summary: The supplied artwork is the appearance reference; opening outfit condition is not yet enacted.
inventory.detail: No armour, weapon, cash, tool kit, ammunition or consumable is granted by the illustration. The penniless opening overrides the ordinary Contractor equipment package.

inventory.name: Ronin runtime shard
inventory.summary: Bounded class runtime, delivered during the opening conversation
inventory.detail: One physical shard, not a full personality construct. Consent and insertion remain your actions in the opening. The level-1 program loadout shown here previews its class capabilities.

journal.title: A new life, off the corporate ledger
journal.body: Night City is the starting point. The story has not begun. This companion previews Fen’s level-1 build and agreed opening equipment; the first conversation with Ronin will happen in play.

journal.title: Fen Vikutā
journal.body: Japan-raised, 29, an Arasaka researcher by trade. Engram modelling, cognitive systems and lab software were familiar ground. Field operations were not. Fen introduces himself surname first; most non-native Japanese speakers call him Fen.

rules.rests: Short rest: 1 hour, restores Contractor slots. Long rest: 8 hours under the normal 2014 rules, restores class resources and half total Hit Dice (minimum 1), but no automatic HP.
rules.convalescence: Once per 24 hours, after 8 hours of rest with food, water and appropriate first aid, spend up to one quarter of total Hit Dice rounded up (half in a stocked clinic). At level 1 this is one d8 + 2, minimum 0 HP. Critical injuries must be treated first.
rules.injuries: The first damaging drop from positive HP to 0 in an encounter causes one critical injury. A critical hit above 0 does not. Standard injuries require treatment and 7 qualifying convalescence days; major injuries associated with a failed death save require surgery and 21 days.
rules.intrusion: Establish a real route and discover a compatible endpoint. Technology +4 is your intrusion check. Fast intrusion may be included in a hostile direct program’s action: failed breach spends the action, not the slot; success then resolves the program normally. Ordinary local discovery is 60 feet; an already known endpoint can use the program’s range through an available route.
rules.capacity: Load may exceed tolerance, with overload risks. The fragment doubles native tolerance; it does not remove installation shock or the need for treatment. Baseline replacements and class apparatus are Load 0.
rules.progression: Level 2 at 300 total XP: two tier-1 slots, three known programs and two Firmware Upgrades. Level 3: Interface Platform. No level-2 or level-3 features are active yet.
